about_the_game:
Spot the Difference × ADV


You are Tapir.

Today, once again,
an animal has come to you
complaining of insomnia.

Eat the nightmares
and save the troubled animals.

[Overview]

“BAKU” is a
single-player mistake-finding game.
Compare the illustrations on the left and right
and find the mistakes.

The ending will branch depending on
the results of the mistake-finding.

Playing time
1 to 2 hours

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: intel UHD graphics 620
  • Storage: 1.5 GB available space
